name: Meme strats
note: Funny chaos calls inspired by CS meme culture (Rush B), Strat Roulette, and wild pro moments (Glock walls, flash spam). Freeze-time shoutable — not serious meta.

strats.description: The classic: knife out, tunnel tunnel tunnel, no plan B — commit as five.
tasks: One flash over for CT spawn
Smoke CT if anyone bought one
Plant for tunnels, never stop swinging

strats.description: Five P90s, zero dignity — spray down tunnels and take the site on vibes.
Flying Scoutsman energy without the gravity — five scouts, jump peek doors, pray.
tasks: Buy SSG-08 only (plus kevlar if rich)
Jump peek mid doors as a pack
First tag goes B doors or A short

strats.description: They always rush B — so stack five on B and laugh if they do.
tasks: All five hold B (platform / car / tunnels)
No mid peek until first contact
Rotate only after plant sound elsewhere

strats.description: Nobody is allowed on mid or A — apps tunnel vision the whole round.
If you can afford it, you AWP — mid becomes a sniper convention.
tasks: Buy AWP if money allows (drop if not)
First pick decides A or B hit
No rushing sites before a mid kill

strats.description: Everyone goes palace and jump-spots ramp like it's 2016 MM.
tasks: Five to palace, no ramp contact first
Flash yourself in if needed — commit

strats.description: One hero peeks window mid; four hide and wait for the free trade montage.
tasks: No saving the bait — trade only
Rotate on first sound after the bait dies

strats.description: No mid, no apps — banana is life. Flash spam and take B on chaos.
tasks: Throw every flash you own before sandbags
Molly / HE car if you have it
Plant for banana, swing CT together

strats.description: G2 overtime vibes — endless flashes into B until nobody can see, then enter.
tasks: Buy max flashes (skip rifles if needed)
Enter only while flashes are popping
Plant fast, hold with whatever guns remain

strats.description: Single-file apps train — no spreading, no thinking, only vibes.
tasks: Line up in apps balcony order
First death: the next two swing instantly

strats.description: Four banana, one A — punish the eternal banana meme rush.
tasks: Four hold banana / sandbags / new box
Util dump on first banana sound

strats.description: Everyone sprints outside like the bomb is already planted — no secret, no ramp.
tasks: Smoke main / garage if anyone has it
Decide A roof or ramp only after first fight

strats.description: Ignore outside entirely — ramp is the only religion this round.
Stack heaven like tourists — if they don't come outside, you still had fun.
Knife through lobby until someone gets a slash — then guns are allowed (The Opener).
tasks: No shooting until a knife or Zeus kill
After opener frag: full spray go A or ramp

strats.description: Skip mid control — dive donut as five and hope CT brains blue-screen.
Full cave / B rush — utility optional, commitment mandatory.
tasks: Five through cave / lane to B

strats.description: Everyone lives on red / A — B is a myth until you hear the plant.
tasks: Retake B as a pack if needed

strats.description: Negev army takes mid — spray the door, spray the dream.
tasks: Spray door and elbow without stopping
After mid: hit the quieter site

strats.description: Silent crouch through water like it's a stealth game — then suddenly it's not.
tasks: Plant for water, hold connector soft

strats.description: Steal their smoke wall — double-smoke the choke and plant behind the void.
tasks: Wait for CT smoke on A entry

strats.description: The round ends in mid or not at all — no site hits until mid is yours.
tasks: No A or B until mid kill or space
After mid: pick a site on vibes
Bomb carrier stays mid until called

strats.description: Live in heaven / camera — if they never look up, you were a genius.
Cyka energy on Cache — checkers to B, no mid lurk, pure chaos.
Main A as a death ball — four in, one late mid for the cinematic lurk frag.
tasks: One late mid / Z for flank

strats.description: Everyone thinks they're the mid player — fight for mid control like it's ranked ego.
tasks: No site stack until mid dies

strats.description: No armor dreams — five Glocks (or USPs on CT) rush long and overwhelm on headshots.
Deagles only — one taps or bust. No rifles, no excuses.
tasks: Play for headshots, no spray rifles
Default mid info then hit a site
Save if you whiff the first two shots… just kidding, commit

strats.description: Guns stay holstered until someone lands a Zeus (or knife) — then full send.
tasks: Close-range hunt for the opener zap
After first Zeus/knife kill: guns free
Hit the nearest site as five

strats.description: Shotguns only on B — if they rush tunnels, it's a horror movie.
tasks: No long peeks — make them come in

strats.description: Decoy dodgeball energy — spam decoys, fake everything, trust nothing.
tasks: Buy decoys over utility if broke
Hold real angles after the third fake

strats.description: The Economy — nobody buys this round. Pistols, pride, and bad decisions.
tasks: Save the ego, not the guns

strats.description: Dual Berettas only — spray and pray into B like it's a movie scene.
tasks: Spray site entry as a wall of bullets

strats.description: Strat Roulette classic — each player may buy only one item this round.
tasks: One buy each (gun OR util OR armor)
Hit the site with the most space
Trade hard — you won't out-aim rifles
